prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: production illustration-only background plate for QuinTaste's mobile walk-in gallery; real UI will be rendered separately by application code.
Primary request: Generate a fresh 4:5 portrait artwork plate, 1024 by 1280 or equivalent 4:5. The supplied approved screenshot is a STYLE AND MASCOT IDENTITY REFERENCE only. Use its exact warm photorealistic plush clay 3D style, sunny peach/ivory cafe, luminous gentle depth of field and EXACT same plump squat Mochi Chef character.
Subject identity: ivory cream steamed-dumpling mascot with a very wide broad full belly, squat flat base, tiny rounded hands attached directly to the body, no neck, no human torso, no legs, soft peaked dumpling shoulders under a broad soft cream chef hat with three puffy lobes and a tilted band. Its body is much wider than tall. Thick dark-chocolate CLOSED happy crescent eyes, round pink cheeks, small CLOSED curved chocolate smile. All of the chef hat and the whole body must be visible and uncropped. Preserve the lovable short round silhouette from the reference.
Composition: character anchored at bottom RIGHT, body roughly 48% of canvas width, character including hat about 46% of canvas height. Baseline at about 90% canvas height. Keep the upper 50-55% and most of the left side spacious and visually quiet for later code-rendered previews. Soft peach cafe backdrop with subtle distant window glow and small out-of-focus green foliage at far edges only. A warm pale wooden table across the bottom, softly fading to clean ivory cream at the extreme bottom; extreme top also fades seamlessly to ivory cream. The illustration fills the canvas, no border.
Text: NONE.
Critical exclusions: absolutely NO words, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logo or brand wordmark, NO status bar, NO phone UI, NO screens showing content, NO floating cards, NO preview rectangles, NO buttons, NO dots, NO interface, NO captions, NO navigation. Do NOT reproduce the screenshot layout. Do NOT render ANY UI. No food photos inside cards. Everything in this output is a real 3D illustrated scene. All prop surfaces are wordless.
Scene action: place the exact Mochi Chef on the RIGHT, despite it being left in the screenshot. It holds a plain wooden cooking spoon upright. A small black cooking pan with a warm wooden handle and sesame mushroom noodles, tofu and bok choy rests on the table to the LEFT of the mascot near the bottom, no burner UI and no floating ingredients. Keep it cheerful and playful. Maintain the mascot size and position requirements.
